data.title: Hull City vs Brentford Betting Pick | English Premier | 2026-10-25 |
data.content:
Brentford had been unbeaten in 10 games in all competitions before the 1-2 defeat to Liverpool last weekend, but they have won just 1 of the last 6 Premier League games. While they have won League Cup ties at Birmingham City and Reading, Brentford have not won an away Premier League fixture since the end of February.  
   
 Yegor Yarmoliuk and Vitaly Janelt are both suspended after picking up red cards last time out. Jannik Schuster will be hoping to travel with the squad. [...] Hull City have not won any of the last 6 games in all competitions, but they have avoided defeat in half of those played. The fight back to earn a 2-2 draw with Everton in the last fixture here means Hull City are unbeaten in 8 at home in all competitions.  
   
 Mohamed-Ali Cho and Lucas Gourna-Douath are both hoping to join the squad this weekend, but Nobel Mendy may have to wait a little longer. The Hull City squad is still stretched to the limit with injuries littered throughout. [...] Last weekend they were really poor in the 1-0 defeat at Fulham, while Hull City may feel a little fortunate to still be unbeaten at home. They have shown plenty of character to come from behind to earn a 2-2 draw with Everton in the last fixture here, but the chances Hull City are allowing has to eventually catch up with them.  
   
 They will feel they can hurt Brentford going the other way, especially with the changes that need to be made in the midfield.
